name: Knight of Grace — hexproof from black stops a black spell but not a red one; Sphinx of the Guildpact's hexproof from monocolored stops both
notes: "Hexproof from black" (CR 702.11d): the opponent's Knight of Grace cannot be the target of your black spells, but can be of your red ones. Before (2026-10-18), every picker read any "Hexproof from …" as full hexproof, so Brute Force left the Knight out. Sphinx of the Guildpact (hexproof from monocolored) is left out of both mono-coloured spells, Gladecover Scout (hexproof) out of both, and your own Grizzly Bears is in both. The Knight reads 6/5: +1/+0 for the black Grasp of Darkness on the board, +3/+3 from Brute Force.
